notes.title: Extended Ending - Summary Screens
notes.notes:
Hello, valued players!

After watching feedback from multiple players I have added a summary for most of the main traveling companions to show what comes after the main story. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44635099/423ef600c1701110f761bd79eb2303c3df5cca36.png[/img]

Gruzi, Neloril, Vogvhathos, Rinagi, and Lubien will always include a customized "aftermath" snippet that shares where they end up based on branching.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44635099/23dd468355b75320edd010dc33846f780e656e48.png[/img]

There are quite a few differences as they are based on romance options, ending type, character approval, and more. Please don't hesitate to let me know if you run into any issues, and as always thank you so much for playing!

~ Corvaena

notes.title: Branch Hotfix v1.1.1
notes.notes:
HOTFIX - v1.1.1.

This update is a minor hotfix to fix a specific branch in the game that would cause an exception.

The branch: (minor spoiler)

If you chose to visit Rinagi during an early group split and do not ask him one of the listed questions the game will later check against this unasked question and cause an error.

A snippet of code has been added that should resolve this issue.

Thank you for letting me know, and for playing!

~ Corvaena

notes.title: Vogvhathos Patch 1.1.0 - Glossary Added!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44635099/e3ccb25288c1498d87641c2845de5658994251e1.png[/img]

Hello, valued players! First, a huge thank you to all of you for over 100 downloads. Each one means the world.

Tonight patch 1.1.0 has gone live, and here is a list of the changes:

[u][b]MAJOR:[/b][/u]

A glossary has been added, as requested.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44635099/234ce358076cef11f052974cfffe999ad4ab43d2.png[/img]

This has information on various lore elements in the game for anyone who needs a refresher or is just curious about the details. If there is anything you would like added, feel free to reach out and let me know.

To access the glossary visit the in-game menu screens and choose Glossary. Note that many of these will be listed as ???? for the first playthrough to avoid spoilers. This may mean you need to replay once to unlock them all. Note the game does have "Auto" and "Skip" features if you wish a quick run through just to unlock them.

Watch for blue words during the story to hint at a new entry unlock.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44635099/e9d24a69abe2aa9652ad4abf1bf28e6bfd557053.png[/img]

[b][u]MINOR:[/u][/b]

A typo fixed - a missing period was found.

[b][u]BUG FIX:[/u][/b]

In the "Decent" ending, a character portrait would display incorrectly for a few dialogue lines. This has been patched and should display properly now.

Let me know if you have any issues!

~ Corvaena
